A '''drag course''' used for [[Podracing/Legends|Podracing]] existed on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Baroonda/Legends|Baroonda]]. The race began within a [[City/Legends|city]] and headed out of the city, over a bridge, and into a set of ruins. From there the course would continue into Baroonda's jungles before entering another set of ruins that led back into another city, where the end of the course was located. The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Navior|"Bullseye" Navior]] was favored on this course, and other racers could compete against him in one-on-one races.<ref name="EiR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The course first appeared, unnamed, in the [[1999]] [[Wikipedia:Nintendo Game Boy|Gameboy Color]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''. It's one of five courses available at the start of the game.<ref name="EiR" />
